📖 How to use

  1. Enter an area value in the first field.
  2. Pick the unit you are converting from.
  3. Pick the unit you want to convert to.
  4. Read the result and the full conversion table for all ten units.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which area units are supported?

Square millimeters, square centimeters, square meters, hectares, square kilometers, square inches, square feet, square yards, acres and square miles.

What is the difference between a hectare and an acre?

1 hectare = 10,000 m² and 1 acre = 4,046.8564224 m². So a hectare is about 2.47 acres.

Can I see all units at once?

Yes — the table shows your value converted into every supported unit at once, so you can compare directly.
